composites.name: biogears_cardiovascular
composites.description: The BioGears cardiovascular circuit (with its renal, cerebral and tissue branches) in the real engine: hemodynamics plus per-compartment pressures, volumes and flows, driven by a hemorrhage and an IV infusion. Optional point, substance and tissue readings.

state_file.description: BioGears state in <runtime>/states or the package's states/ (or an absolute path)

patient_file.description: Patient file in <runtime>/patients (or a path), stabilized once (about 40 s) and then cached; replaces state_file

conditions.description: Chronic conditions applied while the patient stabilizes, e.g. {ChronicAnemia: {ReductionFactor: 0.3}}; with no patient_file, StandardMale.xml. A different patient, not a perturbation

patient_table.description: A Patients.csv (BioGears' template layout, one column per patient); with patient, the patient is generated from it, stabilized once and cached; replaces state_file

patient.description: The Name of a patient in patient_table

substance_table.description: A Substances.csv, or a folder with Substances.csv and/or Compounds.csv (BioGears' template layout): their substances and compounds are added to the engine's substances

circuit_additions.description: New path name -> {source, target, resistance_mmHg_s_per_mL}: a resistance path between two FullCardiovascular nodes in different vascular compartments, added with its compartment link so substances follow. A perturbation: the body responds over time

interval.description: Seconds per update; 0.02 (BioGears' timestep) resolves per-beat/per-breath waveforms. A non-binary-exact interval can lose the final update of a run to float time accumulation.

point_reads.description: Also read every node and path of the circuit, under readings/<circuit>_points/

substance_outputs.description: Substance quantities to read, each {substance, compartment (omit for whole-body values), property, unit}, e.g. {substance: Oxygen, compartment: Aorta, property: PartialPressure, unit: mmHg}; emitted under readings/substances/<substance>/<compartment or body>/. Checked against the state when the composite's process is built

tissue_outputs.description: Tissue values to read, each {compartment, property, unit}: a tissue's composition (MuscleTissue: MatrixVolume, TotalMass, ...) or its fluid (MuscleTissueExtracellular: Volume, Pressure, WaterVolumeFraction); emitted under readings/tissues/<compartment>/

hemorrhage_rate_mL_per_min.description: Initial bleeding rate (BioGears then lowers it with the local pressure); 0 = no bleed

iv_compound.description: Infused BioGears compound (e.g. Saline, Blood_ONegative, RingersLactate)

composites.name: biogears_mechanical_ventilation
composites.description: A patient on BioGears' anesthesia-machine ventilator (pressure control) in the real engine: the respiratory circuit combined with the ventilator circuit, emitting breathing mechanics, airway and lung compartments and the ventilator's settings and circuit. Defaults: intubated, tube, 12 cmH2O / PEEP 1, 12 bpm, I:E 1:2, FiO2 0.21.

composites.name: biogears_whole_body
composites.description: Every module with setpoints on one real BioGears engine (cardiovascular, respiratory, mechanical ventilator, thermal, supplemental oxygen) plus lymph and tissue fluid, so effects that cross circuits appear in one run. Setpoints start at their baselines; the ventilator and cannula start disconnected, and only one of them can be connected at a time. Optional point, substance and tissue readings.

treatment.description: McDaniel et al. 2019 treatment protocol (viva_biogears.protocols): fluid_challenge (Fig 9), antibiotic (Fig 10), refresh_control and refresh_experimental (Figs 11-13); run to its end_h

treatment_start_h.description: Antibiotic and REFRESH start (58 for Fig 13's delayed arm)

drug_readouts.description: Drugs whose concentrations are read (readings/treatment/<drug>); default Piperacillin and Norepinephrine when treated, none otherwise. Give an untreated arm the treated arms' list to record the same stores
